sheets.name: debug_boot
sheets.title: JTAG + SWD headers, boot-request DIP, reset

+3V3_SC: BOOT0 strap ~2 mA closed + BOOTSEL pulls
+3V3: JTAG TMS/TDI 4k7 insurance pulls when driven

sheets.name: mechanical
sheets.title: Mechanical: M3 mounts + chassis-GND bond (fiducials are PCB-only, emitted by the placer)

sheets.name: pd_input
sheets.title: Power inlet: USB-C PD 20V/3A + TPS26631 eFuse

tp_waivers.CHASSIS_GND: chassis island is probeable at every connector shell tab (USB-C/HDMI/magjack); no pad needed

+5V: PG LED (KT-0603R + 1k, ~3 mA) + FB divider 60 uA
+3V3: PG LED (330R ~3.9 mA) + 1V8 PG sense LED chain (330R ~3.9 mA) + FB divider 27 uA
+1V8: PG FET gate divider 10k+100k (16 uA), rounded up

tp_waivers.+VIN_SYS: reg-side of RS1 — probe across the shunt (the +VIN @ pd_input TP is the post-shunt/load side)
tp_waivers.+5V_REG: reg-side of RS2 — probe across the shunt (the +5V TP is the post-shunt/load side)
tp_waivers.+3V3_REG: reg-side of RS3 — probe across the shunt (the +3V3 TP is the post-shunt/load side)
tp_waivers.+1V8_REG: reg-side of RS4 — probe across the shunt (the +1V8 TP is the post-shunt/load side)

+5V_SOM: PG LED (KT-0603R + 1k, ~3 mA) + FB divider 60 uA (SoM module load declared on som_j1)

sheets.name: som_decoupling
sheets.title: SoM power-entry decoupling under the DF40 mezzanine

sheets.name: som_j1
sheets.title: SoM J1: power / USB / STM32 / JTAG / SDIO / ETH MDI

+5V_SOM: SoM module (Zynq+DDR3L+PHYs) ~10 W class at the regulated 4.65 V (P0 rebind) — estimate, refine at bring-up

sheets.name: som_j2
sheets.title: SoM J2: FPGA bank 13/33 IO + VCCO rails

+3V3: Zynq banks 13+33 VCCO (LVCMOS33 static + PL output drive) + on-SoM BMI323 VDDIO rider

sheets.name: som_j3
sheets.title: SoM J3: FPGA bank 33/34/35 IO + VCCO rails

+3V3: Zynq banks 34+35 VCCO static (both +3V3 on this board; bank 35 unused, no LVDS load)
CP2102N active ~14 mA typ + RST 1k pull-up

reset_waivers.CP2102N_RST_N: open-drain RST: 1k pull-up only, internal POR; no RC cap

notes.short: power inlet: VBUS->TVS->bulk->+VIN; CC pair to FUSB302
notes.long: PD power inlet: keep the VBUS path (receptacle -> TVS -> bulk -> +VIN) in one corner so the +VIN plane spreads from a single point; CC1/CC2 route to the FUSB302 (usb_pd block, anchored next to this inlet). PLAN.md round 5: a TPS25940-class eFuse lands between receptacle and bulk — reserve space for it here.

notes.short: USB-C OTG: 90R HS pair short + matched; ESD at conn
notes.long: USB-C OTG: the 90R D+/D- pair wants the shortest matched run to its SoM pins; USBLC6-2SC6 ESD array within ~10 mm of the receptacle; VBUS source switch beside the connector.
JTAG (2x7 2 mm) + SWD (2x5 1.27 mm) headers mate vertically — any top-side spot works; keep cable/probe clearance and the boot DIP reachable.

notes.short: 2 bucks: thermal copper + vias; keep SW loops tight
notes.long: Buck thermal (worst-case declared draws): LM61460AANRJRR +5V_REG ~0.03 W; LM61460AANRJRR +3V3_REG ~0.02 W. Pour copper on the SW/PGND side, stitch vias under the packages, keep each SW node loop minimal.

notes.short: INA3221 shunts sit IN the rail path
notes.long: Power monitor: the shunt resistors are in series with the rails — the rails must physically route through this block; place it between the regulators and the loads, Kelvin-connect the sense pairs.

notes.short: USB-UART conn deferred; TPs on TX/RX
notes.long: CP2102N UART bridge: its USB connector is an author-declared deferral (expect usb_uart_connector) — the block reserves edge space for it; TX/RX test points stay probe-able.
18 test points board-wide (test-point gate): spread them with probe clearance as the blocks settle; none may end up under the SoM.
